Read-only PyMuPDF inspection reports an unused Helvetica resource in all four Round 19 PDFs, zero visible Helvetica text spans, and no embedded Helvetica font program. Resource presence and non-use do not establish licence compliance.
Checked-in SVG stacks vary across Noto Sans SC / Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Inter and Arial fallbacks; concrete fonts resolved by the offline SVG-to-PNG renderer were not recorded.

Local NotoSansSC-VF.ttf name-table version 2.04;241114210130;non-release, SHA-256 763146584cf0710223441356b4395e279021b0806c196614377a7a0174ae074a, declared SIL OFL 1.1.
